basic_info.description:
Wow! Sunny, comfortable unique Condo! Kitch/BA renovated 3 or so years ago new cabinets/counter, GE gas stove, refrigerator & bathroom sink and other touches include steel wall coverings around stove & cooking exhaust unit. Mid-August 2024 entire unit was repainted w/ new carpet. 

Located on the Top Floor, w/nearly 12' ceilings, it overlooks the easily accessiblke garden/backyard. On the corner, both Kitchen & main room are window lined with tons of light, it's private & super quiet. As a bonus for this tiny, yet mighty unit, there's lots of storage space, a walk-in closet with some storage above and bathroom has a storage loft over the tiled shower.

Kitchen has ceramic tile floor and lots of cabinets for storage and windows face Northwest with views of garden, trees, & the western sunset sky. Bathroom matching tiled shower & floor.  And there is a coin-op washer/dryer on 2nd floor.

Located in a vibrant, central neighborhood w/great cafes, restaurants & shops. Lower Haight, Haight-Ashbury, UCSF, USF, Alamo Square Park & the Panhandle/GG Park are nearby. Bottom tenant  is Core Power Yoga studio. Other amenities nearby: Bi-Rite, The Mill, Nopa, The Independent & Emporium Arcade Bar. There are major bus lines (#24,#21,#5) nearby.

A real charmer! Character Galore! Don't Miss it!
